content: The Daily WikiDoc Scholars Meeting takes place every morning at 8:30 AM Eastern Time (Boston time zone) in the Longwood Medical Area, where nearly 20 full-time WikiDoc Scholars convene. The Daily Crowdiagnosis Meeting is held every morning at 9:30 AM Eastern Time (Boston time zone). If you are interested in participating in the Crowdiagnosis Project, you are welcome to join this meeting. The Weekly WikiDoc Board Review Meeting occurs every Monday at 10:30 AM in the Longwood Medical Area. This meeting is led by Will Gibson, an MD-PhD candidate from Harvard Medical School. For further information, you can contact him via email at willjgibson@gmail.com. If you would like to arrange a meeting with a member of the team at a time that suits you, you can do so by sending an email to questions@wikidoc.org.
